overview.description: The first three hires set the culture whether or not you meant them to. In a wet lab they also set the safety practice.
objectives: Decide PhD versus engineer, specialist versus generalist, for the work you actually have
Run a work trial that tells you something a interview cannot
End a hire that is not working, early and decently

steps.intro: The first three hires set the culture whether or not you meant them to. In a wet lab they also set the safety practice.
instructions: Write the first three roles as outcomes, not titles.
Design a paid work trial: real work, scoped to a day or two.
Agree in advance what six weeks of not working looks like.

submission.description: Produce the Hiring Plan and log it against this module in Homeroom. Done means the artefact exists, not that you read the page.
